title: Head Coverings, The Lord's Supper

questions.question: Paul commends them because they remember him in everything and maintain what?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:2 (ESV): "Now I commend you because you remember me in everything and maintain the traditions even as I delivered them to you."

questions.question: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, the head of a wife is her husband, and the head of Christ is ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:3 (ESV): "But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, the head of a wife is her husband, and the head of Christ is God."

questions.question: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head, but every wife who prays or prophesies with her head ____ dishonors her head.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:4-5 (ESV): "Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head, but every wife who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head..."

questions.question: For a man ought not to cover his head, since he is the ____ of God.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:7 (ESV): "For a man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God, but woman is the glory of man."

questions.question: For man was not made from woman, but woman from man. Neither was man created for woman, but ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:8-9 (ESV): "For man was not made from woman, but woman from man. Neither was man created for woman, but woman for man."

questions.question: That is why a wife ought to have a symbol of authority on her head, because of ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:10 (ESV): "That is why a wife ought to have a symbol of authority on her head, because of the angels."

questions.question: In the Lord, however, woman is not independent of man nor man of woman; for as woman was made from man, so man is now born of woman. And all things are from ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:11-12 (ESV): "Nevertheless, in the Lord woman is not independent of man nor man of woman; for as woman was made from man, so man is now born of woman. And all things are from God."

questions.question: Paul shifts to the Lord's Supper. He hears that when they come together as a church, there are ____ among them.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:18 (ESV): "For, in the first place, when you come together as a church, I hear that there are divisions among you. And I believe it in part,"

questions.question: When they come together, it is not the Lord's supper that they eat. For in eating, each one goes ahead with his own meal. One goes hungry, another gets ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:20-21 (ESV): "When you come together, it is not the Lord's supper that you eat. For in eating, each one goes ahead with his own meal. One goes hungry, another gets drunk."

questions.question: Paul asks, "What! Do you not have houses to eat and drink in? Or do you despise the church of God and humiliate those who ____?"
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:22 (ESV): "What! Do you not have houses to eat and drink in? Or do you despise the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing?"

questions.question: For I received from the Lord what I also delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night when he was betrayed took ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:23 (ESV): "For I received from the Lord what I also delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night when he was betrayed took bread,"

questions.question: And when he had given thanks, he broke it, and said, "This is my body, which is for you. Do this in ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:24 (ESV): "and when he had given thanks, he broke it, and said, 'This is my body, which is for you. Do this in remembrance of me.'"

questions.question: For as often as you eat this bread and drink the cup, you proclaim the Lord's ____ until he comes.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:26 (ESV): "For as often as you eat this bread and drink the cup, you proclaim the Lord's death until he comes."

questions.question: Whoever, therefore, eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty concerning the ____.
options: body and blood of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: body and blood of the Lord
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:27 (ESV): "Whoever, therefore, eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty concerning the body and blood of the Lord."

questions.question: Let a person ____ himself, then, and so eat of the bread and drink of the cup. For anyone who eats and drinks without discerning the body eats and drinks judgment on himself.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 11:28-29 (ESV): "Let a person examine himself, then, and so eat of the bread and drink of the cup. For anyone who eats and drinks without discerning the body eats and drinks judgment on himself."

key_verse_text: For I received from the Lord what I also delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night when he was betrayed took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it, and said, "This is my body, which is for you. Do this in remembrance of me."
